body:
Tipranks Press Release.

KKR Credit Income fund Units ( (AU:KKC) ) has shared an announcement.

KKR Credit Income Fund reported a slight increase in its unaudited net tangible asset per unit, with the current estimate rising to $2.3116 as at 21 September 2026 from $2.3114 on 16 September 2026, representing a 0.01% movement. The manager emphasised that the figures are approximate, prepared in Australian dollars, and not verified by the administrator, reiterating that past performance is not indicative of future returns and that investors should rely on formal disclosure documents and advice when making decisions.

KKR Credit Income Fund is an Australian-listed managed investment trust focused on credit investments, overseen by The Trust Company (RE Services) Limited as responsible entity and managed by KKR Australia Investment Management. The fund targets income-focused investors by providing exposure to a diversified portfolio of credit assets, with reporting and administration supported by third-party service providers.

For a thorough assessment of KKC stock, go to TipRanks’ Stock Analysis page .
